checks.command: npm run check:structure && npm run check:boundaries

exit_criteria.evidence: Remote material is copied into a runtime-branded inert quarantine, remains non-executable and inactive, and cannot receive activation authorization without an exact external review, locked disabled installation, passing conformance, and current policy binding.

The canonical SkillLockfile entry pins exact source, revision, normalized tree hash, separately attested signature status, reviewed license, permissions, review status, and approver identities under a deterministic domain-separated lock hash.

review.approval_scope: Exact S03 implementation hashes recorded in S03-C015 and fresh resolving checks S03-C016 through S03-C019; invalid on source or evidence drift.
review.assurance_limit: No separate agent or contract_reviewer performed a second technical audit; the independent decision is the user's external human approval over author-produced technical evidence.

open_risks: The external human approval is not a separate agent-authored technical audit and is valid only for the exact reviewed hashes and resolving evidence.
Static inspection is conservative defense in depth and is not exhaustive malware detection.
Catalog fetch, cryptographic signature verification, installation, sandbox execution, activation effects, Ledger events, and effect receipts require future trusted adapters.
Serialized lockfiles can be integrity-checked but cannot rehydrate runtime authority in this S03 primitive.
The private scaffold package has no declared public export map.
not_verified: Real catalog and packaging variation coverage
Production cryptographic signature and provenance verification
Isolated dynamic sandbox, clean uninstall, and actual activation effects
S04 adversarial red-team gate and Z02 release integration
